name: Social Media Dashboard - End-to-End Navigation and Functionality
description: Verifies that the Streamlit application loads successfully, supports complete sidebar navigation across pages (Home, Dataset Explorer, Exploratory Data Analysis, Feature Importance, About), and displays active system indicators and visual components.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the Streamlit app URL
Verify the top navbar and the header 'Social Media Engagement Dashboard' are visible on the home screen
Verify that the sidebar indicates 'System Online' with a green status badge
Verify the 'Dataset Overview' section shows the count of 'Total Rows' and 'Total Columns'
Click on the 'Dataset Explorer' option in the sidebar navigation
Verify that the Dataset Explorer page header loads and displays raw dataset metrics or profile report
Click on the 'Exploratory Data Analysis' option in the sidebar navigation
Verify the chart tabs like Histogram and Box Plot are visible
Click on the 'Feature Importance' option in the sidebar navigation
Verify the 'Top 5 Most Important Features' Gini metric cards are visible
Click on the 'About' option in the sidebar navigation
Verify that the 'Technology Stack' cards showing Python and Streamlit are visible
